async function callValidateReauthMFA(client: LoginRadius) {
  const type: string = '<type>'; //Required
  const reAuthTwoFAModel = {  }; //Required
  const access_token: string = '<access_token>'; //Optional
  const prevent_webhook: string = '<prevent_webhook>'; //Optional
  const X-PreventWebhook: string = '<X-PreventWebhook>'; //Optional
  const g-recaptcha-response: string = '<g-recaptcha-response>'; //Optional
  const g_recaptcha_response: string = '<g_recaptcha_response>'; //Optional
  const qq_captcha_ticket: string = '<qq_captcha_ticket>'; //Optional
  const qq_captcha_randstr: string = '<qq_captcha_randstr>'; //Optional
  const h-captcha-response: string = '<h-captcha-response>'; //Optional

  try {
    const res = await client.<service>.validateReauthMFA({ type, reAuthTwoFAModel, access_token, prevent_webhook, X-PreventWebhook, g-recaptcha-response, g_recaptcha_response, qq_captcha_ticket, qq_captcha_randstr, h-captcha-response });
